/zab lam nā ro chos drug gi khrid kyi zin bris bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: /zab lam nā ro chos drug gi khrid kyi zin bris bzhugs so/

na mo gu ru/ chos rje nyer gnyis pas mdzad pa'i chos drug bla ma'i zhal las bdag gis cung zad go tshul 'di bri bar bya ste/ de la thog mar dal 'byor gyi mi lus ni/ dal ba brgyad/ 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i mi'i lus rin po che 'di rnyed par dka'/ de la dal ba gang zhe na/ de skad du yang*/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// kla klo tshe ring lha dang ni// log lta sangs rgyas kyis stongs pa// lkugs pa 'di dag mi khom brgyad// dal ba ni de rnams su ma skyes pas dal ba ste dal ba brgyad/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba la/ grangs kyi sgo nas rnyed dka' ba ni/ dmyal ba la sa chen po'i rdul tsam yod par gsungs/ yi dwags la kha ba sa skya tsam yod la/ dud 'gro la rgya mtsho chen por glum dar ma'i sbang ma tsam yod par gsungs/ dpe'i sgo nas kyang rnyed par dka' ba yin te/ de ltar yang*/ spyod 'jug las/ ji ltar rgya mtsho cher g.yengs gnya' shing gis// bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud de las ni// dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par shin tu dka'// zhes gsungs pas na dpe'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba'i tshul mdor bsdus pa'o// rgyu'i sgo nas rnyed par dka' ba ni/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrungs pa zhig nges par dgos/ 'byor pa bcu ni rang 'byor lnga dang*/ gzhan 'byor lnga'o// rang 'byor gang zhe na/ mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang*// las mtha' log gnas la dad// ces gsungs pas/ rang 'byor lnga'o// gzhan 'byor lnga ni/ sangs rgyas byon dang des chos gsungs// bstan pa gnas dang de'i rjes 'jug /gzhan phyir snying nas brtse ba'o// zhes gsungs pas/ gzhan 'byor lnga'o// dal 'byor rnyed pa tsam gyis mi chog mi rtag pa bsgom dgos te/ bshes spring las/ dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las// sad khom gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che// zhes pas dbugs rgyu ba ma chad tsam du gnyid pas/ bde bar sad 'dod pa ngo mtshar che ste/

mi rtag pa sgom tshul ni/ 'chi ba dgu phrugs su bsgom dgos te/ mdo mya ngan 'das chen las/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag gi// mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo// zhes dang*/ mtshan ma bzang po'i mdo las kyang*/ sang tsam 'chi ba sus shes kyis// de ring nyid nas btud de bya// 'chi bdag sde chen de dang ni// bdag nyid bshes pa ma yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ nam 'chi cha med cing*/ shi ba'i 'og nas gang gis kyang phan pa med de/ de skad du yang*/ bdag nyid mal na 'dug bzhin du// gnyen bshes rnams kyis mtha' bskor nas// srog chad pa yi tshor ba dag /bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ dus kyis nyen te rgyal po 'gro gyur na// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*// skye bo de ni gang dang gar 'gro yang*// las ni grib ma bzhin du 'brang bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ las bzang ngan de nyid rnam par shes pa'i rjes su 'brang zhing*/ gzhan gang gis kyang skal pa len du med de/ de skad du yang*/ bshes spring las/ khyod kyis bram ze dge slong lha dang ni// 'gron dang yab yum dag dang btsun mo dang*// 'khor gyi slad du sdig pa mi bgyi ste// dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis// zhes gsungs pas/ rigs drug gang du skyes kyang bde ba med de/ dmyal ba la btso bsreg yi dwags la bkres skom/ dud 'gro la glen lkugs/ mi la brel phongs/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung byed la sogs pa sdug bsngal bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de rnams las skyob pa dkon mchog gsum ma gtogs pa gang gis kyang mi nus pas/ de ltar na dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba gal che ste/ lha'i dbang pos bstod par/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba// de dag ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste// lha yi lus ni spangs nas su// lha yi gnas su skye bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ de bzhin du chos dang dge 'dun la yang sbyar ro// gang las skyabs na/

'tshe ba dang ni thams cad dang*// ngan song du ni gnas min dang*// 'jig tshogs theg pa dman pa las// skyob phyir skyabs kyi dam par 'dod// ces dang gang gis skyob na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi skyabs gnas gnyis yin te/ gnas skabs kyi skyabs gnas ni/ srid pa gsum na rgyal ba dkon mchog gtso// de yi 'og tu de las byung ba'i chos// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyes chen brgyad po ni// gnas skabs kyi skyabs gnas so// mthar thug gi skyabs gnas ni/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin par gsungs te/ de skad du yang*/ rgyud bla ma las/ spangs phyir bslu ba'i chos can phyir// med phyir 'jigs dang bcas pa'i phyir// chos rnams gnyis dang 'phags pa'i tshogs// gtan gyi skyabs gnas ma yin no// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin// thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir// tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir// zhes gsungs pas/ gang skyob na/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag de skyob/ skyabs su 'gro tshul ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gdan bkod pa sna tshogs pa'i steng du/ skyabs yul rnams bzhugs par mos la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byams sogs tshad med bzhi rnams spyi ltar byed de/ de rnams thun mong gi sngon 'gro'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro ni/ byin rlabs 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom pa gal che ste/ rang gi spyi bor seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri padma nyi zla'i steng du/ rdo rje rin po che dang dar zab sna tshogs pa'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dbu la rigs lnga mtshon pa'i phyir rin po che'i rtse phran lnga 'bur ba/

mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa/ thugs ting 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la mnyam par 'jog pa de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin dang 'og min sogs nas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ma lus pa spyan drangs/ badzra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid du gyur/ bla ma rin po che bdag la nges 'byung skyo shas skye bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe 'di blo yi thong bar mdzad du gsol/ mos gus dam bca' brtan par mdzad du gsol/ mi rtag rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol lo// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bo bla ma dam pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// de bzhin du gsung dang thugs la yang sbyar ro// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so// zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs ba spu'i bu ga sogs nas 'od zer sna tshogs pa byung ba dbang bzhi dang sbyar nas/ mthar bla ma yang rang nyid la bstim nas gnyis su med par gyur nas/ de'i ngang la bzang ngan gyi rtog pa dang bral ba/ rig stong dbyer med zab mo'i don la mnyam par ci nus kyi bar bzhag mnyam bzhag de las langs nas bsngo bas rgyas gdab/ de nas sdig sgrib 'dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ pad dkar zla ba'i steng du gnas// rgyan rnams kun gyis legs spras pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gcig po// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris nas// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzhin// nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas gyur na// de yi ltung sogs byin brlabs pas// 'phel ba yang ni mi 'gyur ro// 'bum phrag gcig ni bzlas gyur na// rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/

de ltar na 'di gal che bar gsungs te/ rang gi spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par bya'o// tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi khrid ni/ sgrub pa'i maṇḍal dang mchod pa'i maṇḍal gnyis yin te/ lnga ldan ltar nyams su len/ sngon 'gro'i chos de rnams nyams su blangs/ rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag gis zab lam nā ro chos drug bsgom par bya ste/ de la khrid kyi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun gyi sngon 'gro gnyis yin te/ khrid kyi sngon 'gro bstan zin/ da ni thun gyi sngon 'gro bsgom dgos te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byams sogs tshad med bzhi rnams bsgom par bya ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i phyir du zab lam nā ro'i chos drug nyams su blang bar bya'o// zhes ngag tu brjod/ thog mar stong ra bsgom par bya ste/ stong ra la yang lus kyi stong ra/ rtsa'i stong ra gnyis yin te/ lus kyi stong ra ni rang nyid skad cig gi rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa gsal bar bsgoms pa'i spyi bor gdan bkod pa sna tshogs pa'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs gong bzhin bsgom/ rtsa bde ba rlung 'jam pa lus la gtum mo'i bde drod 'bar ba/ bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skye ba sogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rang la bstim/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du shel sgong rdul dang bral ba lta bu phyi gsal nang gsal du bsgom/ de'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma khang stong la ka ba btsugs pa lta bu yar sne smin mtshams su yod pa/ mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi la zug pa mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa/ chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba/ rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar ba/ til gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ padma'i snal ma ltar phra ba/ de'i g.yas su ro ma g.yon du rkyang ma/ yar sne sna bug la zug pa/ mar sne dbu ma la yar zug pa/

yi ge cha'i rnam pa zhig bsgom/ de nas 'khor lo bzhi ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab ma brgyad/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab ma bcu drug spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo la rtsa 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis la rtsa sum cu so gcig tshigs phran drug cu la rtsa bdun re/ mdor na skyes bu khams snyoms pa gcig la/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa lnga gnas par gsungs te/ de skad du yang*/ nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ phyi ni sgyu ma lha yi sku// nang na rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi// steng na ham̐ yig rnam pa can// 'og na a shad tsaṇḍa lī// steng 'og rlung gi 'khor lo'i dbyibs// srog rtsol bum can nyams len gyis// bar na bde stong gsal ba'i nyams// ming yang gtum mo'i gdams pa zer// rlung gnad du chud dam lo tsā ba// zhes gsungs pas/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ ngas tha mal gyi dus su gtum mo bsgom// chags pa kun skyed cing skyed cing bsgoms// 'dod chags su song yang nyam nga med// lhun grub tu shes pa'i gdeng zhig yod// ces gsungs pas/ de yang gtum mo bsgom pa la/ rlung sbyang ba gnad che ste/ rngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// mda' ltar 'phen dang rnam pa bzhi// rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan ma shes na// yon tan skyon du 'gyur nyen yod// zhes pa ltar sbyangs/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ yan lag gi rlung lnga/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga ni/ gyen rgyu thur sel mnyam gnas khyab byed srog 'dzin/ yan lag gi rlung lnga ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rlung rlung gi rlung*/ mdor na gang zag khams snyoms pa zhig la/ rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu zhing*/ dbu ma'i ngo skal la nga drug bzhi cha/ ye shes kyi rlung bcu gcig yin/ da ni gtum mo'i bsgom tshul brjod par bya ste/ ma zin pa zin par byed pa'i gtum mo/

zin pa brtan par byed pa'i gtum mo/ brtan pa bogs 'don par byed pa'i gtum mo dang gsum mo// dang po rtsa gsum 'dus mdor/ a shad kyi mgo gyen du bstan pa zhig bsams nas rlung rngub cing bzung nas/ ro rkyang gnyis su ltar ltar song nas a shad la phog pas me mtshan nyid bzhi ldan zhig 'bar nas dang po me sor do tsam/ 'bring mthe bong tsam/ bya rog gi sgo nga tsam zhig bsam/ des ma zin pa zin par byed pa'i gtum mo/ gnyis pa zin pa brtan par byed pa'i gtum mo ni/ 'khor lo bzhi po mes 'gengs pa de/ zin pa brtan par byed pa'i gtum mo/ gsum pa bogs 'byin pa la/ drod kyi bogs 'byin pa dang*/ bde bas bogs 'byin pa gnyis yin te/ me cher byung nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mes khengs pa de drod kyi bogs 'byin pa yin la/ me phyi ma rnams 'khor lo la bsdu/ 'khor lo rnams sa bon la bsdus te/ slar yang sa bon a shad la 'jog pa bde ba'i bogs 'byin pa la zer/ yang rlung bzung nas ro rkyang du btang bas/ a shad las me 'bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bsregs/ yang dbu ma nas me byung nas/ lha mo lnga'i sa bon bsregs/ de nas me dbu ma'i nang du song ham̐ la reg pas/ byang sems ba thag lta bu babs te/ a shad la reg pas/ de 'bar 'dzag byas pas bde ba'i bogs 'byin pa'o// zhes dang*/ rgyud brtag gnyis las/ lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar bas// de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bsregs shing*// spyan ma la sogs yang bsregs pas// bsregs pas ri bong can ham̐ 'dzag /zhes gsungs pa ltar du'o// mchog gi gtum mo ni/ sa bon yang mi dmigs par 'jog pa de yin/ de skad du 'ang*/ gtum mo lam gyi rmang rdo yin// 'od gsal lam gyi bogs 'don yin// sgyu lus lam gyi gzhung shing yin// rmi lam lam gyi tshod 'dzin yin// 'pho ba lam gyi skyel ma yin/ bar do lam gyi sun ma yin// zhes gsungs pas/

chos drug gi rtsa tshig yin la/ 'od gsal bsgom pa la sngon 'gro stong ra sogs gsal 'debs ma gtogs pa gong ltar yin la/ dmigs pa'i ngo bo la/ rang gi snying gar rtsa dbu ma'i nang du/ padma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa/ de'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa sor gang tsam 'od gsal ba zhig bsgom/ des kyang ma zin na/ bla ma'i thugs khar padma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po 'od 'tsher ba shel dam du mar me bcug pa lta bur bsgom/ des kyang ma zin na hūm̐ dang thig le rdo rje yin pas 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa'o// rje nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ gnyid dang rmi lam bar zhig na// gti mug chos sku'i ngo bo can// brjod med 'od gsal bde ba'i nyams// rjes la 'od gsal rgya yis thebs// rmi lam 'od gsal mthug po nyid// ming yang 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag zer// sems skye med du rtogs sam lo tsā ba// zhes dang*/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ ngas gnyid kyi dus su 'od gsal bsgom// rtog pa kun sdud kyin sdud kyin bsgoms// gti mug tu song yang nyam nga med// chos skur shes pa'i gdengs shig yod// ces dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas// rmi lam 'od gsal du 'pho nus na// bar do'i grong khyer logs na med// ces dang*/ yang phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ 'od gsal zin pa'i go ba de// gnyid kyi dngos por gyur pa yang*// stong gsal nam mkha' mtha' dbus med// ting nge 'dzin du gyur pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa dang*/ rgyab skyor rnams tshar ba'o// nyin par gyi 'khrul snang dkar dmar du 'dzin pa'i gnyen por/ rmi lam gyi gdams par/ de skad du yang*/ nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ rmi lam nyams kyi 'khrul ba'i dus// mgrin pa oṃ yig 'od zer can// dran 'dun bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor las// skyes pa rmis na pho 'dre zer// bud med rmis na mo 'dre zer// byol song rmis na klu ru 'dzin// dga' ba rmis na sems dpang skye// mi dga' rmis na nyams mi dga'// 'dre sems kyi rtsa ba ma shes na// rnam rtog gi 'dre la zad pa med// bzang ngan rang grol ston pa'i don// ming yang rmi lam gyi gdams ngag zer// rang bzhin shes sam lo tsā ba// zhes gsungs pas/

dmigs pa ni sngon 'gro stong ra sgom pa rnams gong dang mtshungs la/ spyi bor bla ma bzhugs pa la dmigs la gsol ba 'debs tshul ni/ bla ma rin po che bdag gi rgyud la rmi lam mang po gsal po/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes par mdzad du gsol/ rmi lam sprul sgyur nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// rang gi mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa zhig bsgom/ de'i nang du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang du bsgoms nas/ bla mas yang rmi lam yin gsungs par bsam/ rang yang rmi lam yin bsam pa byas nas/ bla ma'i mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa zhig bsam pa'i steng du/ oṃ dmar po zhig bsam/ mdun du āḥdakar po zhig g.yas su nu ser po zhig rgyab tu ta dmar po zhig g.yon du ra ljang khu zhig rnams bsam la/ dang por āḥde la shes pa gtod/ de nas yang nu la shes pa gtod/ yang ta dang ra sogs la shes pa gtod/ gnyid la 'gro kha rang bla ma'i thugs kha'i oṃ rang la shes pa gtad nas nyal na/ dmigs pa zin nas rmi lam zin yong*/ de skad du yang ni gu ma'i zhal nas/ rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad yig a 'thas shig /ces gsungs pas/ de ltar na nyin par yang 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug ci byed kyang rmi lam yin bsam pa dang ma bral bar bya/ des ma zin na/ dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhig bsam/ de'i steng du thig le dkar po yung 'bru tsam zhig bsam/ des kyang ma zin na/ thig le ga'u kha sbyor du bsgom/ des nges par zin nas yong*/ de nas rmi lam sprul pa ni/ gcig mang po bsgyur zhing*/ mang po gcig tu bsdu/ spel ba ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong ba'o// 'dis rmi lam gyi man ngag rnams/ gnad tshang bar bris pa yin/ mtshan mo gnyid rmi lam nying 'khrul sna tshogs kyi gnyen por sgyu lus kyi gdams pas te/ gtso bor gdams pa bzhi yin te/ sgyu lus la yang*/

dag pa rgyu lus dang*/ ma dag sgyu lus gnyis te/ rje nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ phyi na snang ba sgyu ma tsam// nang na nyams myong smra ma btub// nyin mtshan snang ba sprul pa'i sku// ming yang sgyu lus kyi gdams ngag zer// zhen pa log gam lo tsā ba// zhes gsungs pas/ de ltar na sgyu lus bsgom pa gal che ste/ rang gi mdun du shing khru gang btags la/ maṇḍal btags te/ de'i nang du rang gi byad bzhin 'char bcug la/ g.yas g.yon gnyis nas bstod ra smad ra'i tshig mang po lab ste/ dga' sdug ci snang blta/ dga' sdug mi 'dug na/ rang yang de dang 'dra bar dmigs nas/ me long gzugs brnyan de byung la/ rang dang me long bar du bzhag yang dga' sdug la sogs pa gong bzhin no// gzugs de rang la bstim/ skyid sdug la sogs ci byung yang rten med du blta bar bya ste/ me long gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs/ bdag blo 'khrul pa ma gtogs phyi rol na gang yang yod ma myong snyam du bsams la/ chags sdang sogs blo mi byed/ 'byongs ma 'byongs lta ba sogs khrom dang grong gseb phyin la lta bar byed/ 'byongs pa'i tshad ni/ chags zhen gang yang med par thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i snang ba byung na 'byongs pa'i tshad yin te/ de skad du yang*/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te// rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byed// de la ji bzhin snang ba gang yang med// chos rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis// ji ltar mi gang nags khrod rgyu ba bzhin// glu len pa dang dgod dang ngu ba dang*// brag char grags kyang de la snang ba med// chos rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis// dag pa sgyu lus la sbyong bar byed pa'i thabs dang*/ dag pa sgyu lus dngos gnyis/ sbyong byed thabs ni/ bris sku 'gying log me long du 'char ba sogs gong bzhin sbyong*/ dag pa'i sgyu lus ni/ gsang 'dus rim lnga las/

rnam shes gsum po slar yang ni// rnal 'byor pa yi lus su 'byung*// sgyu ma'i lus zhes de la bya// kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu// khyab pa chu yi zla ba bzhin// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid las/ khong stong khyod kyi sku la med// sha dang rus pa khrag kyang med// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon bzhin// khyod kyi sku ni ston par mdzad// zhes pa'i don ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po lha skur shar ba'i don yin no// rje mi la'i zhal nas/ rnam shes ma mthong ye shes mthong*// sems can ma mthong sangs rgyas mthong*// 'khor ba ma mthong myang 'das mthong*// chos can ma mthong chos nyid mthong*// zhes dang sa ra ha'i zhal nas/ rmad byung nam mkha'i dkyil du bhū su ku// sna tshogs me tog shar ro bhū su ku// me tog de ni kha dog sna tshogs ldan// me tog de ni stong nyid dgon par skye// zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no// de skad du yang*/ 'pho ba lam gyi skyel ma yin// zhes gsungs pas/ de la yang rten can du 'pho ba dang rten med du 'pho ba gnyis yin te/ rten med du 'pho ba ni phyag rgya chen po'i don no// rten can du 'pho ba ni/ stong ra bsgom pa rtsa skyed pa sogs sngar ltar yin la/ rtsa dbu ma'i yar sne kṣas bkag pa/ mar sne a dmar po zhig bsam/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po zhig bsam/ spyi bor gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bsgom/ rlung rngubs pa la brten nas/ a de hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ de yar spar nas/ kṣa la reg pas/ cung zad kṣa de 'phar nas/ yar sne cung zad skya har re gsal bar bsgom/ phyir 'bebs pa'i dus yi ge rnams rang gnas su bskyal te/ kṣas bkag par bsam/ de ltar lan mang du byas pas/ 'byongs pa'i rtags ni spyi gtsug za ba dang 'phrig pa dang*/ chu ser 'byung ba sogs rtags 'byung ste/ des 'pho ba sbyong ba'o// de nas dus la bab pa dang*/

las la sbyar ba ni/ sa bon bla ma bsgom pa ni sngar ltar yin la/ ka hig lan bcu gcig gi spar te/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam/ de nas yang ka hig bcu gcig gis mgrin par sleb par bsam/ de nas yang ka hig lngas spyi gtsug gi kṣa bsal te/ bla ma'i thugs khar bstim/ bla ma yang mi dmigs par don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang la bzhag des nges par 'pho nges so// de skad du yang*/ bar do lam gyi sun ma yin zhes gsungs pas/ de yang skyes bu de 'chi ba'i dus su/ sa chu la thim pas rtags su lus kyi mdangs mi gsal/ nang rtags smig rgyu lta bu 'byung*/ chu me la thim pas du ba/ me rlung la thim pas srin bu me khyer 'byung*/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas/ mar me 'bar ba/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim pas/ sprin med nam mkha' lta bu/ yang snang ba'i ngo bo 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu thim pa'i rtags la/ skya rengs shar ba lta bu'am kha ba bab pa lta bu dkar lam pa 'byung*/ yang mched pa'i ngo bo zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum thim pa'i rtags la/ dmar lam pa thams cad khrag gis khyab pa lta bu 'byung*/ gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun thob pa thim pa'i rtags ni/ nag thim pa 'byung*/ de'i rjes su thams cad stong pa 'od gsal 'char te/ de ngos zin na/ chos skur 'tshang rgya ba'o// de nas yang rlung phra mo gcig la brten nas nyer thob gzugs 'byung*/ snang ba mched pa gsum lugs ldog ste/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i lha skur ldang bar gsungs te/ de skad du yang*/ rnam shes gsum po slar yang ni// kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu// khyab pa chu yi zla ba bzhin// rnal 'byor pa yi gzugs su ldang*// sgyu ma'i lus zhes de la bya// zhes gsungs pas/ de nyams len gyi zin na bar do longs spyod rdzogs par sangs rgya'o// ma zin na bar dor rnam smin gyi lus len te/

de skad du yang*/ sngon 'byung srid pa'i sha tshugs can// dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu// las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan// zhes gsungs pas/ bar do'i tshe'i tshad ni/ zhag bdun yin par gsungs te/ skye gnas ni ma nges te/ de skad du yang*/ srid pa bar dor rdzus te skye// kha cig mngal las skye ba yang yod// ces gsungs te/ de ltar skye gnas ma nges pa'o// de yang bar dor ya nga ba'i g.yang sa chen po gsum/ 'jigs pa'i dgra bzhi'o// de yang 'jigs pa'i dgra bzhi ni/ sa khams thim pa'i dus su ris mnan pa lta bu dang*/ chu rlung thim pa'i dus su rgya mtsho chen po 'khrug pa lta bu dang*/ me thim pa'i dus su sa gzhi bar snang thams cad me 'bar ba dang*/ rlung gi rlung thim pa'i dus su nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing sa gzhi la rdeb pa lta bu'o// ya nga ba'i g.yang sa gsum ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro gsum mo// de rnams dus su bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gis zin pa gal che'o// 'di rnams kyis bar do'i dmigs rkang dang bcas pa legs par gtan la phab pa yin no// yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang pos brjed kyis dogs nas zin bris su bkod pa 'di la bla ma mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bzod par gsol/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba// dam pa gnyis po thob par shog /theg mchog dam chos rin chen bshad 'di las// bsod nams mtha' yas bdag gis gang thob pa// des ni 'gro kun theg mchog dam pa'i chos// rin chen dri ma med pa'i snod gyur cig /dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig //maṅga laṃ//
